context: ChatMessages opens a WebSocket to stream real-time messages for the active chat room. Users switch rooms frequently.
explanation: The cleanup function that calls ws.close() was removed. When roomId changes, the effect runs again and opens a new WebSocket without closing the previous one — each room switch leaks an open connection, and stale sockets keep pushing messages from old rooms into the current view. Fix: restore return () => ws.close() so every connection is cleaned up when the room changes or the component unmounts.
